title: The Fourth, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: White fireworks. Chloe is in Newport at the diner ten days earlier and now gone. Wood draws the dock and leaves her seat on it empty on purpose.

panels.composition: The dock, fireworks white on blue. GULLY pouring. MARIA in the chair. WOOD on the steps with BARNABY II. At the dock's end, a space on the planks where nobody sits, drawn as a space.
props: an empty space on the dock end

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks with a conspicuous empty space on the planks at the dock's end, a man in an apron pouring, a woman in a lawn chair, a thin man on shack steps with a three-legged dog, clean ink with a blue wash
image.notes: The empty seat, the strip's device, on the dock where she sat in 2002 and 2005.

balloons.text: And she counts from the cafeteria.

image.prompt: two men on shack steps at night speaking quietly

panels.composition: The empty space on the dock's end, closer. Fireworks light on the planks.

image.prompt: close-up of empty wet dock planks at the end of a dock lit white by fireworks, no words

panels.composition: The finale. White. The dock. The space. Everyone else.

image.prompt: a fireworks finale in white over a blue night bay above a dock with one empty space at its end among a crowd, watercolor, no words

art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Her seat left empty on the dock. 'She counts from the cafeteria.'
